intro: Spirit of the Wind is a repeatable ritual offered by the captive quilboar Mangletooth in Camp Taurajo. By channeling the residual power within Agamaggan's blood shards, Mangletooth infuses travelers with swiftness to outpace the vast savannas of the Barrens.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Bring Mangletooth 10 blood shards and I will bless you with great speed. You will run with zhevra and the wind will be jealous of you.
It will not last long, but it should be enough to help you travel throughout the Barrens.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good. Go with Agamaggan's spirit as your guide, traveler. Return to me if you desire more of Agamaggan's magics.
